title: Act: Implement round model, transition table and FileStore
summary: Create round.go and store.go in internal/round
description: Create the round package: Status type and 13 constants, Round struct with yaml tags, Transitions map, CanTransition and Round.Transition, and FileStore with Get, Save and List.
acceptance_criteria: Transitions follow SCHEDULED→OPEN|CANCELLED, OPEN→CLOSED|CANCELLED, CLOSED→ANALYZING|FAILED|CANCELLED, ANALYZING→PLANNING|FAILED, PLANNING→DEVELOPING|FAILED, DEVELOPING→TESTING|FAILED, TESTING→BUILDING|FAILED, BUILDING→PUBLISHING|FAILED, PUBLISHING→COMPLETED|FAILED, FAILED→RECOVERING|CANCELLED, RECOVERING→ANALYZING|FAILED|CANCELLED
COMPLETED and CANCELLED have no outgoing transitions
FileStore.Save never leaves a partial round.yaml

steps.symbol: new: Status, Round, Transitions, CanTransition, (*Round).Transition, ErrIllegalTransition
steps.action: Declare type Status string with constants StatusScheduled..StatusRecovering (values are the upper-case names), Round{ID, WorldID, Number, Status, StartsAt, EndsAt, BaseRelease, FreezeCommit, ClosedAt} with yaml tags id, world, number, status, starts_at, ends_at, base_release, freeze_commit, closed_at; Transitions map[Status][]Status per the acceptance criteria; CanTransition(from,to) bool; (*Round).Transition(to) error returning fmt.Errorf wrapping ErrIllegalTransition and leaving Status unchanged when not allowed
steps.expected: Package compiles; Transition mutates Status only on legal moves

steps.symbol: new: FileStore (Root string), Get, Save, List, RoundDir
steps.action: Add FileStore with Root; RoundDir(worldID, roundID) validates both with safepath.Segment and returns filepath.Join(Root,"worlds",worldID,"rounds",strings.ToLower(roundID)); Get reads round.yaml (yaml.v3) and returns ErrNotFound when missing; Save marshals to a temp file in the same dir then os.Rename to round.yaml, MkdirAll 0o755; List(worldID) reads rounds/* dirs and returns all rounds sorted by Number
steps.expected: Round round-trips through round.yaml; unsafe ids error
